_note: Draft for the Learning cycle (docs/CONTRACTS.md §8). One table for every surface; the service sends only the keys. Not read by the shipped dashboard yet.

signal_type.outcome: a result that told it something

wait.agent_active: Waits until your agent is quiet
wait.thermal: Waits for the machine to cool down
wait.model_server: Waits for the model to be loaded in your model server
wait.unsupported: This model cannot learn here yet
wait.error: Stopped by an error · run songe doctor

practice_drop.decision: had no clear moment to decide
practice_drop.matters: the lesson did not matter there

check.general: Didn't change how it answers in general
check.drift: Didn't change what it already did right

health_ok: no rise in loops, empty answers or broken tool calls
health_not_reached: not checked: it did not answer better
checks_rule: The new version is used only if every check passes.

health_fail.Repetition rate increased: repeated phrases more often (older, stricter check)

check_unit.gap: distance from the hindsight answer (lower is better)

outcome.kept: Not used · your model stays as it was

reason.capability_drop: it got worse at making valid tool calls
reason.repetition: more of its answers got stuck repeating themselves
reason.repetition_rate: its answers repeated phrases more often (an older, stricter check, since relaxed)
reason.other: it did not pass its checks
reason.drift_limit: it changed too much on things it already did right

judged: Better on {count}, worse on {worse}, same on {same}
examples_unchecked: This Dream's before/after examples were made before they were checked, so none are shown
nothing_improved: No answer got clearly better this time

dream_notice.pause: Learning paused · nothing learned so far is lost
dream_notice.resume: Learning resumed · the Dream carries on where it stopped

restore_confirm: Go back to {version}? New sessions use it from now on; the newer version is kept and you can return to it.
versions_only_original: The original model is in use. A new version appears here when a Deep Dream passes its checks, and you can always go back.
remove_lesson_title: Remove this preference from new sessions
remove_lesson_confirm: Remove this preference? New sessions stop getting it, and Songe will not add it again.
undo_quick_confirm: Undo this Quick Dream? The preferences it added leave new sessions, and Songe will not add them again.
undone: {version} is kept but no longer in use · {current} in use
held_out_passed: Closer to the corrected answers on held-out conversations: {change}, more than the noise of {margin}
held_out_failed: Not clearly closer on held-out conversations: {change}, within the noise of {margin}
control_failed: Could not do that · {error} · try again; if it still fails, run songe doctor
auto_dream_title: Dream on its own when your computer is idle

quick.title: Quick Dream
quick.about: Learns your preferences and applies them right away

deep.title: Deep Dream
deep.about: Hones skills; used only if it passes its checks

preferences_about: Added to every new session. When a Deep Dream learns one, it leaves the prompt.
preferences_empty: None yet · a Quick Dream adds the preferences it learns from your feedback
waiting_about: Skills it will practise and train in its next Deep Dream.
cancel_confirm: Cancel this Dream? What it has done so far is thrown away; what it practised waits for the next Deep Dream.
quick_running: Quick Dream · reading your newest conversations…
quick_nothing: Nothing new since your last Quick Dream ({when}) · talk to your agent first, then dream again
now_line: Now · {prefs} · {waiting} waiting for a Deep Dream

quick_steps.compare: Try the new preferences on your conversations

dream_stopped.practice: Your Deep Dream stopped while writing practice: the model kept failing to answer. Nothing was changed.
dream_stopped.reading: Your Deep Dream stopped while reading your conversations: {detail}. Nothing was changed.
dream_stopped.training: Your Deep Dream stopped before training: {detail}. Nothing was changed.
dream_stopped.restart: Your Deep Dream was interrupted when Songe restarted. Nothing was changed.

dream_stopped_why.Waiting for calibration growth: it had to measure this machine again for the longer practice scenes and could not
dream_stopped_why.Waiting for memory: there was not enough free memory
dream_stopped_why.Waiting for usable held-out conversation: it needs a few more of your conversations to check its work
dream_stopped_why.Waiting for learnable experience: none of the practice fit what this machine can train
dream_stopped_why.Waiting for new learnable experience: there was no new practice to train on
dream_stopped_why.Waiting for experience: there was no practice to train on yet (practice is written from your conversations' lessons)
dream_stopped_why.ReadTimeout: the model did not answer in time (it may have been busy or unloaded)
dream_stopped_why.ConnectTimeout: the model server did not answer (it may have been busy or unloaded)
dream_stopped_why.ConnectError: the model server could not be reached (is it running?)
dream_stopped_why.RemoteProtocolError: the model server closed the connection

dream_stopped_kept: {kept} practice scenes kept for next time.
collecting_next: A Deep Dream needs {count} more test moment{s} to check its work · each conversation where you give feedback adds up to 3
measuring_machine: Getting to know this machine · measuring how much {name} can learn at once · a few minutes · nothing is learned yet
measuring_next: Then it can learn in Dreams
measured_can: {name} can learn on this machine · Dreams can train it from now on
measured_cannot: {name} can't learn on this machine: {reason} · Songe still works for it, without training
control_unreachable: Can't reach Songe · it may have restarted · reload the page
page_error: The page hit an error · reload it

quick_failed.unreadable: Quick Dream {when} couldn't read your conversations: the model's answers weren't readable · they stay unread and are read next time
quick_failed.no_model: Quick Dream {when} couldn't start: no model is loaded in your model server
quick_failed.memory: Quick Dream {when} couldn't start: memory was tight on this computer · close some apps, then press Quick Dream
quick_failed.load_memory: Quick Dream {when} couldn't start: not enough free memory to load the model · close some apps, or load the model in your model server, then press Quick Dream

quick_checked_read: Quick Dream {when} read {read} · found {found} · no new preferences

quick_failed_card.unreadable: Couldn't read your conversations: the model's answers weren't readable · they stay unread and are read next time
quick_failed_card.no_model: Couldn't start: no model is loaded in your model server
quick_failed_card.memory: Couldn't start: memory was tight on this computer · close some apps, then press Quick Dream
quick_failed_card.load_memory: Couldn't start: not enough free memory to load the model · close some apps, or load the model in your model server, then press Quick Dream

getting_ready: Getting ready · testing how much your computer can learn at once · {done} of {total} tokens so far
getting_ready_title: Getting ready to train · testing how much your computer can learn at once · {done} of {total} tokens so far
measure_about: Measuring how much this computer can learn at once · nothing is trained in this step
measure_longer: now testing longer readings (the teacher sees more of the conversation) · {done} of {total} tokens
quick_example_where: On the conversation it came from
quick_example_same: No visible change at the moment it came from
catching_up: Catching up on your earlier conversations. After this, Quick Dreams take a few minutes.
next_after_quick: Then the preferences in the prompt update
next_after_reading: Then the preferences in the prompt update · a Deep Dream starts after a long quiet period
machine_line: {name} · {memory} GB · can train models up to about {size}B (estimate)
machine_title: An estimate from this machine's memory, for dense models trained in 4-bit. Each model's real limit is measured before its first Deep Dream and shown on its page.
training_window: trains on up to {window} tokens per conversation

training_limit.conversations: enough for your conversations so far

training_unmeasured: Training window: measured before its first Deep Dream

cloud.badge_title: Dreams may ask {model} via {provider}; your agent still runs on your own model
cloud.signature_on: Your agent stays on this machine · Dreams use a cloud model
cloud.turned_off: Cloud learning off · no more calls
cloud.best_effort: This endpoint reports no prices · the budget is best effort
